title: Grid cells of a lookup column show the raw foreign-key id in their hover tooltip, so hovering beside "Restricted record" (or beside a readable lookup's name) still reveals the id
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named landing point and a reach**. Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post #5560, project run by the Sales account, `session_01WJozybDmRH8z2c5SD7vJkj`) from the review of PR #13376 (objectui#13335). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and labels are triage's.

**Who acts:** the `domain:ui` seat 1, by a sub-agent, after triage grades it. It needs a contract-review pass at `TIER_DEFAULT` because it adds a member to the published `TableColumn` type.

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** any object grid with a `lookup` / `master_detail` column; every viewer.
- **Now:** the generic table's plain cell wrapper sets its `title` to `String(cellValue)` for every non-masked, non-object value. For a lookup column, `cellValue` is the referenced record's raw id. So hovering the empty space beside the cell's drawn name shows the id. After PR #13376, a lookup the viewer cannot read shows "Restricted record" with no id in its text, but the same hover still shows the id. objectui#13335's Done-when ("no link and no id … in grids") is met for the visible text and not for this tooltip.
- **Evidence:** read in the DOM by the #13376 dev (its PR's Acceptance notes). Not checked in a real browser.

## Landing (read on objectui `origin/main` `8cf3a86`)

- `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, the cell wrapper's `title={!isFit && !col.masked && cellValue != null && …}` expression. objectui#10583 already drops this tooltip for masked columns, so the precedent is there.
- The column reaching it carries no field type: `ObjectGrid`'s last column pass runs `normalizeTableColumnType` (`packages/types/src/data-display.ts`), which keeps only the table's own types, so `lookup` / `master_detail` / `tree` arrive untyped. The same pass already carries two field-type facts through as `TableColumn` booleans, `masked` (objectui#10583) and `chips` (objectui#12708); neither can be reused (`masked` also blocks copy, CSV export and inline edit; `chips` only sets a width).
- Measured shape of the fix (about 15 non-test lines, three packages): declare one optional `TableColumn` boolean for a reference column in `@object-ui/types`, set it in `ObjectGrid`'s last pass from the column's type, and skip the tooltip for it in `data-table`.

## Done when

- Hovering a lookup / master_detail cell in a grid shows no tooltip carrying the raw id, for a readable and for a restricted reference.
- Every other column keeps its tooltip (a plain text column still shows its value).
- A grid pin for both, with a control.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: objectui issue search (repo-scoped, any state) on `tooltip lookup id` in titles at 2026-10-23T14:25Z: 3 hits, all closed and other surfaces: #5492 (the inline lookup dropdown's subtitle and option tooltip), #5195 (the lookup dropdown's recent-items filter), #2125 (the inline lookup editor's trigger). **New.**
